candidate_workaround: Split owner-file, status, x1-protection, and commit-count probes into independently bounded commands.
failure_signature: A combined owner-file and status probe exceeded its twenty-second wrapper without attributable output.
recurrence_guard: Do not repeat the combined probe; run bounded status and file-count queries independently.
rollback: Give the timed-out wrapper zero evidence credit and leave repository and external state unchanged.
scope_boundary: Same-owner bounded workflow recovery only; no scientific, authority, production, or independent-reproduction credit.
title: Decompose owner-state probe after wrapper timeout
trigger_preconditions: A combined read-only owner-state probe times out without attributable output.
